finding: The all-tail extension and its four-circuit successor contain an invalid upper-envelope lower-bound step when the final node lies in the open second odd band: F>0 there, so E_actual<=U gives F*E_actual<=F*U, not the needed lower bound. No counterexample has been shown. The original gap-case theorem with final node in (d,e) is unaffected; tail positions outside (c,d) remain covered by the additive analysis, and the new early-third-node proof remains valid when u3<=b or u3=c. With those qualifications only three whole conservative 5-finite-plus-infinity phase words are excluded: (2,1,2,5,4), (2,1,3,2,5), (2,1,3,5,4). Word (2,1,3,2,4) remains open when the fifth node is in (c,d); the other eight words are also open. Checkpoint068's four-node/all-tail claim must not be used without this correction.
